title: ARIES: A Corpus of Scientific Paper Edits Made in Response to Peer Reviews

layout.note: Inputs on the left (the comment note on top, two page thumbnails below with dashed ties); in the middle two stacked task rows headed by large bold titles, each a chip, a lilac model box and bars; at the right a column of blue example boxes, two gold edits for Alignment and one generated edit for Generation, tied to the rows by dotted leaders.

lesson: Define two related tasks by fanning the same inputs into two stacked rows (input chips, black-box model, example output) and tie compact bars to full-text examples by dotted leaders; a tick and cross card shows what an alignment output looks like.
